topic: Agent Skills specification and SKILL.md format
query: Agent Skills spec SKILL.md Anthropic Open Standard 2025 2026
title: SKILL.md Is Becoming the REST of Agents. Nobody Told You Yet. | by Automation Labs | Medium
snippet: SKILL.md is the Agent Skills open standard: a single markdown file with YAML frontmatter that describes a reusable capability for AI coding agents. An Agent Skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file — a set of plain-English instructions, plus optional scripts and reference files — that Claude loads only when it's relevant to your task.
claim: SKILL.md is an open standard using markdown with YAML frontmatter to describe reusable agent capabilities.

topic: Agent Skills release timeline and adoption
query: Agent Skills spec SKILL.md Anthropic Open Standard 2025 2026
title: SKILL.md Is Becoming the REST of Agents. Nobody Told You Yet. | by Automation Labs | Medium
snippet: In October 2025, Anthropic introduced Agent Skills — a way to teach Claude a repeatable workflow once and have it apply that workflow automatically whenever it's relevant. On December 18, 2025, Anthropic released Agent Skills as an open standard, publishing the specification and SDK for any AI platform to adopt.
claim: Anthropic introduced Agent Skills in October 2025 and released it as an open standard on December 18, 2025.

topic: Cross-platform Agent Skills adoption by major vendors

topic: Agent Skills registry format and distribution
title: AI Agent Skills Guide 2026: SKILL.md, Claude Code, Codex & Security - The Prompt Index
snippet: A registry entry format for skills, inspired by server.json but adapted for the Agent Skills spec, uses namespace/name identity with reverse-DNS and supports both git and OCI distribution. A complete spec with JSON Schema has been developed.
claim: Agent Skills registry uses namespace/name identity with reverse-DNS and supports both git and OCI distribution.

topic: Progressive disclosure in Agent Skills loading
query: Agent Skills spec SKILL.md Anthropic Open Standard 2025 2026
title: SKILL.md Is Becoming the REST of Agents. Nobody Told You Yet. | by Automation Labs | Medium
snippet: Agents load skills in three tiers: name + description at startup (~100 tokens per skill), the full SKILL.md body on activation (recommended under 5,000 tokens), and reference files only when needed.
claim: Agent Skills use progressive disclosure loading in three tiers: startup metadata, full body on activation, reference files on demand.

topic: Agent Skills as repeatable workflow encapsulation
title: What Are Agent Skills and How To Use Them
snippet: Agent Skills are folders of instructions that package repeated workflows, specialized knowledge, or new capabilities for an AI agent, allowing you to write instructions once as a skill and reuse them across every conversation.
claim: Agent Skills package repeated workflows and specialized knowledge, written once and reused across agent interactions.
